r.b: Q: Will there be meal breaks during the tournament?

r: There will be a 30-minute meal break on Day 1 to allow Duelists to eat. Announcements will be made the Round prior to the start of the break and a 30-minute time clock will be set. Duelists who do not arrive for the next Round on time will incur
. There will be no meal break on Day 2.

r.b: Q: How many Rounds will YCS Lima 2025 have?

r: The total number of Duelists once registration closes will determine the number of Rounds that are played.

r.b: Q: How many Duelists will advance to Day 2?

r: If there are 256 or fewer Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 15 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 257 – 512 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 513 – 1024 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 128 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.

r.b: Q: How many Duelists will advance to the Top Cut?

r: The tournament will cut to Top 8 after all rounds of Swiss are completed and prizes will be awarded down to 32
place based on the standings of active Duelists.

r.b: Q: I want to vend at YCS Lima, who should I contact and by when?

r: Vending space is available free of charge at Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series venues but is only available to Official Tournament Stores in good standing. Vendors must meet certain requirements and agree to abide by set guidelines. Interested vendors should email opsupport.lat@devir.com with the subject line “Request to Vend at YCS Lima 2025.” Vendors will be required to complete and apply for each event at which they wish to vend. For this YCS, all applications must be submitted no later than September 14
Keep in mind that KDE-US and Devir Americas handle the applications for vending at Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series events, and not the Tournament Organizer.

Cash transactions with anyone other than an approved vendor at an approved location is prohibited at Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series events. Attendees who conduct cash transactions, such as selling cards or products, to anyone other than an approved vendor at a Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series event risk penalties including disqualification and expulsion from the venue.

Anyone buying and/or selling as an unauthorized vendor at a Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series venue may also risk incurring penalties, including but not limited to, being disqualified and removed from the event, suspensions from KONAMI Organized Play, and suspension as an Official Tournament Store.

r.b: Q: Do I need a visa to enter Peru if I am from a different country?

r: Most countries from Latin America do not require visas for stays of 90 days or less; however, it is highly advisable to contact your local consulate for the most up-to-date information.

It is essential when entering Peru to present a valid passport with a minimum validity of six months from the date of entry into the country. Citizens of Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, Ecuador, Colombia, Bolivia and Chile can enter with their national ID document
